kernel_variant: B2 — int4 weight via image2d (CL_RGBA + UNSIGNED_INT8), activation still char* buffer

image_layout.texel_packs: 2 i4 groups per texel (.x/.y for slice_i=2*pair, .z/.w for slice_i=2*pair+1)

notes: Decode (W=1) saw the headline win: 14.8x speedup. Texture cache eliminates the weight-read latency that previously dominated the memory-bound single-token path. 90 GOps/s now, up from 6.

Prefill / FFN shapes are all ~1.6x faster. The compute side is the same; only the weight access pattern changed. Throughput plateaus near 655 GOps/s — next bottleneck is likely the dot-product issue rate, addressable by sub-group / tile widening (Tier S2).

Intel Arc Meteor Lake-P refuses both CL_R+UINT16 and CL_R+UINT32 image2d reads at SPIR-V level (undefined ImageRead opcode) even with the sampler-less form, and refuses CL_RGBA+UINT8 too. The kernel is therefore Adreno-only for now. Intel debugging is deferred — Adreno is the production target.
Setup overhead (clCreateImage + clEnqueueWriteImage) is not measured here — only the kernel itself. For an inference graph the image2d is allocated once at model load.
